def factor_volatility_instability_range(df):
    """Volatility instability using normalized intraday range as the short-horizon volatility proxy."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    vol_short = intraday_range.rolling(10, min_periods=5).std()
    vol_change = vol_short.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std()
    df_copy["factor_volatility_instability_range"] = vol_change
    return df_copy["factor_volatility_instability_range"]
description: Parent strength: RankICIR=0.6609 and payoff monotonicity=0.927 from the original close-return vol-of-vol factor. Bottleneck: raw IC/ICIR and sensitivity to extreme intraday stress. Mutation preserves the core vol-of-vol mechanism but replaces close-to-close realized volatility with normalized intraday range before the two-stage rolling standard deviation. Intraday range is more responsive to same-day panic and price-span expansion, potentially improving IC without altering the relative rank stability that made the parent qualified. The factor remains a raw single-stock signal; no cross-sectional transform is applied.
